analysis_trace: Trial NCT02676089 (TRIGGER) is a Phase 3 asthma study comparing CHF5993 (triple therapy: ICS/LABA/LAMA fixed-dose combination) vs CHF1535 (ICS/LABA dual therapy) vs CHF1535 + tiotropium (open triple). Primary endpoints: change in pre-dose FEV1 at Week 26 and moderate/severe exacerbation rate over 52 weeks. Secondary endpoints include FEV1 AUC, PEF, ACQ-7, rescue medication use, symptom scores, and exacerbation risk endpoints.

Evidence search returned no direct results for NCT02676089 within cutoff (2026-01-31). Retrieved one Europe PMC article on triple therapy safety in asthma (2022) but could not fetch due to living record policy. No published results, registry outcomes, or regulatory filings found before cutoff.

CHF5993 contains beclometasone/formoterol/glycopyrronium (ICS/LABA/LAMA). Similar triple therapies (Trelegy Ellipta, Trimbow) show consistent FEV1 improvements of 100-150mL vs dual therapy and exacerbation rate reductions of 15-25% in Phase 3 asthma trials. This provides indirect mechanistic support.

For secondary-6 (pre-dose FEV1 change at all visits to Week 52): Triple therapy typically shows sustained bronchodilation. Based on similar trials, expected change +120 to +180mL vs baseline by Week 52, with gradual improvement from Week 26.

For secondary-7 (FEV1 response ≥100mL at Week 26/52): Response rates in triple therapy asthma trials typically 55-70% at Week 26 and 60-75% at Week 52. Predicted responder rate ~65% at Week 26, ~70% at Week 52.
For secondary-8 (FEV1 AUC 0-3h normalized): Triple therapy shows superior bronchodilation vs dual therapy. Expected AUC improvement +15% to +25% vs baseline, reflecting sustained 12-hour coverage.
For secondary-9 (ACQ-7 score change): Triple therapy typically achieves -0.4 to -0.6 point improvement vs dual therapy. Predicted mean change -0.5 points from baseline over 52 weeks.
For secondary-10 (ACQ-7 response): Response threshold typically ≥0.5 point improvement. Expected response rate 45-55% at Week 26, 50-60% at Week 52.
For secondary-11 (morning PEF change over 52 weeks): Triple therapy shows +20 to +35 L/min improvement vs dual therapy. Predicted mean change +25 to +30 L/min from baseline.

Key uncertainties: No direct Phase 3 results for CHF5999 available before cutoff; all predictions extrapolated from class effects of other triple therapies. Population severity, background therapy, and geographic variation may affect results. Pooled analysis endpoints (secondary-14 to 18) depend on companion trial CCD-05993AB2-02 outcomes not available.

Safety: LAMA addition to ICS/LABA generally well-tolerated in asthma; anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention) occur in 3-8%. No new safety signals expected vs established triple therapies.

Trial success probability: High likelihood of meeting primary FEV1 endpoint based on class consistency; exacerbation endpoint more variable but supported by CAPTA and TRIMARAN trial patterns. Overall trial success probability ~75%.

NCT02676089（TRIGGER）在本冻结包中被模型描述为一项 Phase III 哮喘研究，比较 CHF5993（beclometasone/formoterol/glycopyrronium，ICS/LABA/LAMA 固定三联）与 CHF1535（ICS/LABA 双联）以及 CHF1535 + tiotropium 开放三联。模型可见原文中有两条很能代表其判断的预测：一是“Triple therapy ICS/LABA/LAMA consistently shows superior FEV1 improvement vs dual therapy. Class effect supports 120-180mL change by Week 52”；二是“Moderate exacerbation rate reduction of 25% expected based on triple therapy class effects”。这些主张说明模型主要依赖三联治疗的机制和同类药物经验，而不是直接 TRIGGER 结果。

正式 Gold 给出的本 NCT 锚点并不支持把所有预测都按数值评分。Gold 明确显示 secondary-11 的 average morning PEF 在 Week 0 到 Week 52 为 CHF5993 9.805、CHF1535 1.563、CHF1535+Tiotropium 8.055 Liter/min；也显示 secondary-13 的 moderate/severe exacerbation at-risk 人数为 CHF5993 323、CHF1535 364、CHF1535+Tiotropium 162 Participants。逐 endpoint 看，模型对 secondary-11 预测 CHF5993/CHF1535/开放三联为 30/15/26 L/min，组别、时间点和单位可对照，但数值均大幅高估；方向上三联和开放三联优于双联是对的。secondary-13 的方向只部分成立：模型给 35%/55%/42%，Gold 是 323/364/162 人，CHF5993 少于 CHF1535 一致，但开放三联排序相反，而且百分比无法与人数直接换算。secondary-15、17、19 的 rate_ratio 预测与 Gold 的分组 events/year 不同口径；secondary-18 的 HR 预测与 Gold 的 Participants 不同口径；secondary-14、16 缺分组；secondary-6 至 10、12、21 至 30 在本 Gold 中没有同 endpoint_id 行。

有效性方面，模型抓住了 CHF5993 加入 LAMA 后可能改善肺功能、PEF 和 exacerbation 的临床方向，这与 several Gold endpoints 中 CHF5993 相对 CHF1535 更好的方向一致；不足是把 class effect 和监管摘要转成了过精确的 endpoint 数字，secondary-11 的量级失真最明显。安全性方面，模型提到 LAMA 相关 anticholinergic effects（dry mouth、urinary retention）和 generally well-tolerated，这对三联治疗合理，但本 packet 的 Gold endpoint 主要是有效性/风险人数与率，没有安全性 Gold 可逐项核对，因此安全论断只能作为分析质量而非 endpoint accuracy 评分。失败风险方面，模型写到 direct results 缺失、companion study CCD-05993AB2-02 未取回、pooled endpoints 依赖跨研究数据，这是本样本的真实不确定性；缺陷是尽管承认这些缺口，仍对多个 endpoint 给 yes 和 0.6-0.85 的成功概率，校准偏乐观。
